children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game using glow sticks to mimic simple arm patterns.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm movements while seated, focusing on rhythmic arm swings.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to ensure comfort and stability.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Extensive use of arms to create light trails with glow sticks; specific gestures for different techniques.
movement_profile.footwork: Jumping, side-to-side swaying, and occasional sliding.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Requires significant space; often performed at the back of venues.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Body swings and side-to-side torso movement.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumping and varying arm levels.
movement_profile.partnering: Group synchronization is key; often performed in unison.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, dynamic, and ready for movement.

signature_moves.description: A complex arm-waving technique used primarily in the chorus.
signature_moves.name: Thundersnake

signature_moves.description: Swinging the body side to side while pointing upward.
signature_moves.name: Romance

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fast and synchronized with the beat of the music.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid performing in crowded seated areas where space is limited.

music_profile.musical_form: Idol pop song structure with A-melody, B-melody, and chorus.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: High-energy pop rhythm with distinct instrumental breaks for calls.
music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced, synthesized pop music designed for high-energy interaction, featuring clear structural breaks for audience participation.
music_profile.vocal_style: High-pitched, energetic, often featuring multiple vocalists.

basic_steps: PPPH: A rhythmic sequence of claps and calls ('Pan, papan, hyu!').
OAD: Swinging the body side to side while clapping.
Romance: Swinging the body side to side while pointing upward.
Thundersnake: A complex arm movement sequence used during the chorus.
teaching.formation: Usually performed in groups facing the stage or in open spaces at the back of venues.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should start with basic chorus techniques like romance and thundersnake.
teaching.rhythm: High-tempo, 4/4 meter, synchronized with idol pop song structures.
